source.title: Automatizzare la copertura updater del software esterno, incluso RDC
source.objective:
fedora-external-updater is active and passing daily runs, but Remote Desktop Commander is installed only inside ~/.npm/_npx/.../@wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander and is not present in inventory/latest.json or reports. The scan roots exclude ~/.npm, and npm_global is report-only anyway, so RDC is outside automatic update coverage despite the repos

Related governance gap to solve in the same batch:
Upstream governance gap: fedora-external-updater dynamically inventories software but its managed updater set and per-source apply policy are static; discovered manual/new software is never promoted into managed coverage. MegaVault has no active canonical rule requiring newly installed Fedora software that is outside Fedora/Flatpak/etc automatic update coverage to be registered/reconciled with fedora-external-updater, and no enforcement hook validates that every installed software item has an update owner. fedora-system-monitor already has software inventory/change detection and a software.path trigger, but it does not reconcile ownership/update coverage and its watched paths/metadata sources also omit transient npx cache installs such as RDC. This is the upstream cause of RDC falling through both Fedora and fedora-external-updater.
source.current_action: Read-only npx discovery and update-ownership gap reporting implemented in the existing local-only updater checkout; automatic replacement awaits an explicit process owner.
source.next_action: After the user selects a managed install/restart owner or confirms report-only policy, resume this same updater source branch. If managed, implement an explicit updater and bounded restart/rollback acceptance; preserve the running process until then. Publish the local-only source through an authorized route; the pushed C2 recovery patch preserves the current change.
source.blocker: The only observed RDC process is a manually launched npx @latest terminal session with no managed restart or rollback owner. Auto-updating its live package or replacing the process would be unsafe; the source repository also has no remote publication route.
